fields.description: Al Ghadeer Gardens brings townhouses and villas to the Abu Dhabi–Dubai border corridor. The design pairs private gardens with pedestrian routes, landscaped recreation areas and a community centre. Two and three bedroom townhouses sit alongside four bedroom villas.

sources.label: Aldar: Al Ghadeer Gardens brochure and plans

reviewCoverage.identity: Own official May-2026 Gardens release verified, kept separate from N2 and Parks.
reviewCoverage.location: Official launch places development on Abu Dhabi–Dubai border within Al Ghadeer; no unsupported area ID assigned.
reviewCoverage.residences: Official factsheet and brochure identify two/three-bedroom townhouses and four-bedroom villas.
reviewCoverage.areas: Four floor-plan drawings visually checked. They show room dimensions but no verified aggregate area; numeric areas withheld.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Dedicated official page and factsheet checked.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Original AED 1.7m starting reference retained with developer-reported launch sell-out, not current stock.
reviewCoverage.payment: Official-branded factsheet visually confirms 55/45 and 5% down payment; remaining 50% aggregated without invented dates.
reviewCoverage.handover: Launch factsheet gives Q4 2029; current plot completion remains subject to developer update.
reviewCoverage.documents: Downloaded official 45-page brochure; plans on pages 40–43 and one-page factsheet visually inspected.

overview: The official layouts distinguish a middle and a corner three-bedroom townhouse. Both use ground and first floors, while the villa provides a different garden and parking arrangement. Request the selected plot drawing before comparing usable space.
research.locationNote: Aldar places the project along the Abu Dhabi–Dubai border. The established Al Ghadeer neighbourhood and the new Gardens release should be distinguished when checking routes and existing facilities.
research.priceNote: The launch factsheet lists AED 1.7m. Aldar announced the initial release sold out on 21 May 2026. This historical starting figure is not evidence of an available home at that price.
research.paymentNote: The factsheet sets out 55% before handover, including a 5% deposit, and 45% at handover. The intermediate 50% is grouped below because an independently verified instalment calendar was not established.
research.handoverNote: Q4 2029 is the launch factsheet’s estimated handover. Confirm current timing for the individual plot; it must not be transferred to later Al Ghadeer releases.
